name: thoughts
title: Thoughts
description: A personal observation, reflection, memory, feeling, story fragment, or random note.
examples: The city feels different when it rains.
Time seems to pass faster as I get older.
The dragon sleeps beneath the abandoned station.
I learned that trees communicate through fungi.
I keep thinking about that conversation.

name: ideas
title: Ideas
description: A proposed possibility, invention, improvement, creative concept, or suggestion.
examples: What if notebooks could sort themselves?
We could build a tiny solar powered greenhouse.
Maybe start a neighborhood book exchange.
Idea for a story: a city that forgets its name.
A browser extension that remembers useful quotes.
How about adding a weekly summary?
It would be useful to search notes by mood.
Could build a lamp from recycled glass.

name: todos
title: To-do
description: An action, intention, reminder, obligation, or task to complete.
examples: I need to reply to the landlord.

name: questions
title: Questions
description: A request for an answer, explanation, information, or something to investigate.
examples: How does a database index work?
Where did I leave the charger?
What time does the train leave?
Is the library open on Sunday?
Which book should I read first?

name: links
title: Links
description: A saved website, reference URL, Markdown link, or bookmark.

name: junk
title: Junk / code
description: Code snippets, logs, markup, attachment placeholders, test strings, or discarded noise.
examples: def add(a, b): return a + b

name: work
title: Work
description: Company updates, client context, team decisions, project status, or professional information to retain. Explicit actions can still be to-dos.
examples: The client approved the revised roadmap.
Our team owns the billing service.
The launch was moved to the next quarter.
The company is opening a new office.
The engineering meeting covered capacity planning.
The customer prefers weekly status reports.
The new team lead starts next month.
